changelog:
CHAOS Memory 0.1.3

- Auto-capture is now strictly opt-in and disabled by default for privacy.
- Default config paths for the consolidator and auto-capture updated (`consolidator.yaml`).
- Documentation improved for enabling/disabling auto-capture, privacy details highlighted.
- Minor config structure changes for clarity and a safer installation experience.
summary: Hybrid search memory system for AI agents. Manual search and storage - auto-capture is opt-in only.
